title: Patent PreCheck
description: Keyless 12-tool patentability MCP: USPTO pillar scores, prior art, hosted at patentprecheck.com/mcp.
summary: Keyless 12-tool patentability MCP: USPTO pillar scores, prior art, hosted at patentprecheck.com/mcp.
offersHint: Keyless 12-tool patentability MCP: USPTO pillar scores, prior art, hosted at patentprecheck.com/mcp. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://patentprecheck.com/mcp · Packages: npm:@patentprecheck/mcp

toolsPreview.name: precheck_score
toolsPreview.description: Run a patentability pre-check on source code or an invention description. Returns a 0–100 patentability score across the four USPTO statutory pillars (§101 eligibility, §102 novelty, §103 non-obviousness, §101 utility), a separate §112 filing-readiness signal, the band (Not Ready → File Ready), the pillar that holds the band back, top opportunities to strengthen, and a count of prior-art matches consulted. Pass the text to analyze inline via `code`.

toolsPreview.name: precheck_prior_art
toolsPreview.description: Return the closest prior-art matches consulted for an invention (titles, sources, similarity scores, URLs). Runs the same analyze pipeline as precheck_score but focuses on retrieval results. Pass invention text via `code`.

toolsPreview.name: precheck_rejection_patterns
toolsPreview.description: Preview examination-risk signals: similar office-action rejections, abandonment patterns, and the primary statutory basis an examiner might cite (§101/§102/§103). Use after precheck_score to explain prosecution risk.

toolsPreview.name: precheck_legal_context
toolsPreview.description: Return a short snippet of current US software-patent legal guidance (CAFC, USPTO, Alice/§101) relevant to scoring this invention. Informational only — not legal advice.

toolsPreview.name: precheck_pillars
toolsPreview.description: List the five patentability pillars (with statutes and weights) and the band rules used by precheck_score. Use this to explain a score to the user. No network call.

toolsPreview.name: precheck_start_review
toolsPreview.description: Return the URL where the user can start a paid (or promo-unlocked) Interactive Code Review that strengthens each pillar with evidence and produces a filing package. Use after precheck_score when the user wants to act on the result.

toolsPreview.name: precheck_search_corpus
toolsPreview.description: Fast semantic search against the 2M+ prior-art corpus without LLM scoring. Returns ranked matches with similarity scores. Cheaper than precheck_score when you only need references.

toolsPreview.name: precheck_cpc_suggest
toolsPreview.description: Suggest Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) codes for an invention description. Offline heuristic — informational only. No network call.

toolsPreview.name: precheck_session_status
toolsPreview.description: Return status for an active Interactive Code Review session. Requires report_id and session_key from the user access email link.

toolsPreview.name: precheck_deliverables
toolsPreview.description: Return download URLs for finalized ICR deliverables (filing packet, coaching report, package zip, scorecard PDF). Requires report_id and session_key.

toolsPreview.name: precheck_lookup_patent
toolsPreview.description: Resolve a US patent or application number (e.g. US1234567B2) via USPTO Open Data Portal and optionally join the indexed prior-art corpus. Returns title, status, CPC, grant-text excerpt, and a public URL. No API key required in the MCP client.

toolsPreview.name: precheck_compare_to_patent
toolsPreview.description: Compare invention text to a known US patent: embedding similarity plus prior-art risk analysis (statute hints, overlap theme, distinction checklist). Use when the user names a specific reference patent.
